rules.name: producer_consumer_resident
rules.notes: Output remains resident through its consumers unless a later capacity conflict evicts it.
rules.stay_condition: Live activation buffers fit after farthest-next-use eviction
rules.permanents: Outputs with future consumers; released after final consumer

rules.name: producer_consumer_spill
rules.notes: Output is written externally because it has no future consumer, exceeds capacity, or is selected for eviction.
rules.stay_condition: Live activation buffers fit after farthest-next-use eviction
rules.permanents: Outputs with future consumers; released after final consumer
